predictive_evaluation.protocol: sequential one-step-ahead over all matches in narrative order; each match is predicted from prior information only, and draws are scored as half a win plus half a loss for every system. Systems freeze at different boundaries: filtered WHR at the unit, Glicko-2 at the chapter, and sequential ELO at the individual match -- so elo_sequential alone can see the other pairings of the unit it is predicting, which are driven by the same net scores. elo_unit_frozen is the like-for-like row
